n, k = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(float, input().split()))
zeroCount = sum(1 for val in a if val < 1e-10)
k = min(n - zeroCount, k)

p = [0.0] * (1 << n)
res = [0.0] * n
p[0] = 1.0

for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
    sumA = 0.0
    validMask = True
    countBits = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            sumA += a[i]
            if a[i] < 1e-10:
                validMask = False
            countBits += 1
    if not validMask:
        p[mask] = 0.0
        continue
    sumP = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        if mask & (1 << i):
            denom = 1.0 - sumA + a[i]
            sumP += (a[i] / denom) * p[mask ^ (1 << i)]
    p[mask] = sumP
    if countBits == k:
        for i in range(n):
            if mask & (1 << i):
                res[i] += p[mask]

print(' '.join(f"{res[i]:.10f}" for i in range(n)))
</translated_code>
